📖 Active Book Series

Level 1 • Fold 1

The Twins Saga

Active Development

The narrative adaptation of Pandora Raven and Elara Dawn's 300,000-year cycle. Following the strict creation thesis: every track forms an emotional foundation that translates directly into chapter narrative and character demonstration.

Album 0.5 — In the Beginning...

Book I: Dawn's Raven

The separation at birth. Pandora's descent into the southern monastery while Elara is forged into the Church's weapon in Mydaal.

Album 3 & Album 3.5

Book II: Box of Little Horrors vs. House of Miracles

Ideology turns to warfare. Cities fall as Pandora curates damage and Elara builds the resistance before their first face-to-face meeting.

Album 6 & Album 6.5

Book III: The Age of Destruction

The Seven enter the field. Elara sheds the title of War to ride as herself, ascending the Northern Tower while Pandora releases Apollyon.

Album 8 & Album 9

Book IV: The Convergence & Rise of SOLARA

The paradox resolved. Illuminate transfers complete memory across time, setting up the twin-flame alignment and the birth of SOLARA.
